title: A Mentor's Nexus Dispatch shows in a feed

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), feed review of #3259 (LIVE-682).

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: compose-kinds maps a nexus Dispatch to visibility 'region' and createPost sets scope_id to the nexus region, but feed_for_viewer and scoped_feed_for_viewer (newest definitions in 20270346002000_cluster_reads_every_circle_channel.sql) read only public, group and cluster posts. The Dispatch is saved and nobody sees it, the author included. LIVE-682 is closed with a probe that checks the picker strings. THE FIX: a migration adding the region branch (p.visibility = 'region' and p.scope_id = the viewer's region) to both feed functions, or drop nexus from dispatchScopesFor until a reader exists (which would fail LIVE-682's probe, so it needs the owner's word).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if((()=>{const d='supabase/migrations';const f=fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.sql')&&/function public\.feed_for_viewer/.test(r(d+'/'+x))).sort().pop();const t=r(d+'/'+f);const i=t.indexOf('function public.feed_for_viewer');const body=t.slice(i,t.indexOf('revoke all on function public.feed_for_viewer',i));return !/'region'/.test(body)})()){console.error('SCAN-839: no feed reads a region-visibility Dispatch');process.exit(1)}"
